Versioned authenticated ASGI research-job API, owner-derived read/write scopes, bounded request admission, readiness, OpenAPI and typed SDK (PR-047)

Hash-locked CPU dependency/build profiles, two-snapshot wheel rebuild checks, dependency SBOM and encrypted verified local snapshot/restore with lease fencing (PR-048; no container/offsite/production acceptance)

The PROMETHEUS-X final-project addendum (ECONOSIM-X): point-in-time-safe feature/label eligibility gating, classical persistence/AR(p)/VAR(p) forecasting baselines, and a real World Bank Open Data ingestion (PR-055/056/060)

RECESSIONNET recession classifier (base rate/logistic/classical-MLP/hybrid-quantum, validation-selected early stopping) and the `prometheus.quantum` differentiable circuit layer it introduced (PR-139, corrected PR-141/142), independently re-grounded on a real Kaggle macro snapshot (GDP/unemployment-claims/Fed-funds/M2/NASDAQ, PR-145) and a real US Treasury yield-curve feature (PR-178)

Q-MACRO quantum-vs-classical regression benchmark (PR-143) and MACROCORE's classical AR/VAR/persistence baselines extended to a shared-Transformer-encoder multihorizon GDP/rate/unemployment forecaster benchmarked against them (PR-183)
INFLATIONCAST mixed-frequency CPI nowcasting against real BLS CPI data, with an uncertainty-calibrated recurrent model and a real browser dashboard view (PR-173)

CONTAGION-GNN interbank-contagion graph classifier, VOLTERRA-GEN a labeled conditional scenario generator, POLICYLAB-RL a constrained-PPO-vs-Taylor-rule policy benchmark, and a shared-vs-independent multi-task encoder ablation (PR-182)

PDE solvers (PINN/deep BSDE), multi-agent RL household/firm policy training, and a REINFORCE hedging agent each newly orchestrated as a submittable job kind, alongside a unified React/TypeScript frontend and JSON dashboard views over all of the above (16 job kinds total, PR-174)
A frozen, dated final-project hypotheses document and a final paper assembling every frozen and disclosed null/negative result (PR-172/179)

A real-vs-known-fixed CI pipeline (eight genuine bugs found and fixed by actually running it, not just editing it -- a YAML syntax error, a missing lockfile extra, a wheel-install path assumption, a numpy-version-specific type error, and three distinct classes of cross-machine floating-point/timing non-determinism), and a `prometheus.webgateway` reverse-proxy that serves the existing React frontend's real build output plus Docker packaging for the whole stack, independently verified on a real Docker-capable CI runner (PR-185/187)

`prometheus.trading_readiness`: real, tested EXT-* mechanisms for all 10 of the 12 EXT-* items whose acceptance criteria name a recurring system behavior rather than a one-time external deliverable (a mock broker, a pre-trade risk gate, a one-way kill switch, position/cash reconciliation, a 5-distinct-role arming gate, fault-injection response, an append-only surveillance log, a shadow-trading harness, a capital-risk budget reusing TITAN's risk metrics, and an import-graph isolation guard) -- every mechanism runs only against an in-memory mock broker that makes no real network call; the institutional half of each EXT-* item (a real broker agreement, real named officers, real capital) remains exactly as unmet as before this package existed; EXT-02/09 name a one-time external deliverable no mechanism can address and stay untouched on purpose (PR-188/189)
scope_prohibited: Live trading, order routing, or any connection to a brokerage

Live or real-time market data feeds, and any real client or portfolio holdings -- the historical, licensed macro/market datasets used for offline research and backtesting (World Bank, Kenneth French factors, a Kaggle FRED mirror, BLS CPI, the US Treasury yield curve; see scope_enabled) are a disclosed, narrow exception to this, never live or client data
Any claim of regulatory, model-risk, or security certification

neural_sde.design_record:
Neural SDE design record
=========================
State variables (2):
  - KAGGLE_NASDAQ_YOY  [percent, year-over-year]
  - KAGGLE_GDP_YOY  [percent, year-over-year]
Regime/conditioning features (3):
  - KAGGLE_FEDFUNDS  [percent, annualized rate]
  - KAGGLE_CLAIMS_YOY  [percent, year-over-year]
  - KAGGLE_M2_YOY  [percent, year-over-year]
Time unit: months (dt=1.0 per monthly observation)
Constraints:
  - state variables are YoY growth/level rates, not price levels: no positivity constraint applies (the real KAGGLE_GDP_YOY series reaches -7.69% in 2020-05, its most negative value in the entire 1981-2023 sample -- see neural_sde.ood) -- the positivity constraint this package enforces instead is finiteness and a hard architectural bound on drift/diffusion magnitude (neural_sde.model)
  - diffusion output must be a valid covariance matrix (symmetric PSD) by construction, not by a post-hoc repair step (neural_sde.model's Cholesky parameterization)
  - regime features and state are read only through econosim.pit.build_feature_vector, so no training or evaluation event can see a feature not yet eligible as of its own decision time (neural_sde.dataset)
  - normalization statistics are fit once on the training split only and frozen before being applied to validation/test (neural_sde.dataset.FittedScaler)

limitations: trained on ~40 years of MONTHLY observations (a few hundred rows) -- too little data to support a high-capacity architecture, hence the deliberately small hidden_size used throughout this package
regime features (KAGGLE_FEDFUNDS/CLAIMS_YOY/M2_YOY) are treated as exogenous/observed, not themselves modeled as stochastic -- a joint model of regime evolution is out of scope

the diffusion covariance is state- and time-dependent but has no explicit mean-reversion term the way Heston's CIR variance process does -- nothing prevents the network from learning an unconditionally explosive-feeling (though always architecturally bounded, see neural_sde.model) diffusion surface in regions far from the training data's support
evaluated against one real out-of-distribution event (the 2020 COVID window, neural_sde.ood) -- this is one data point about OOD behavior, not a general OOD guarantee

the GARCH/AR1/persistence baselines in neural_sde.benchmark are univariate-only or structurally simplified (see that module's own docstring) -- they are comparison points, not independently production-grade models
